notes: Operator decision 2026-10-19: keep a separate table of accounts proven to spam, and report every post of theirs we see (no daily cap, any team or side). The legacy evidence/EV reporter is paused. Revisit after the first rulings. Rules: an upheld post pays 25 (first reporter) or 5; per target team per day full, half after 5, 10% after 10; any genuine ruling stops all our reporting for 6 hours; ~1 ruling in 4 is wrong.

copy_paste.notes: shared_text only for campaign lines (stance words) and never when any pre-open account posted the same text: identical small talk across new accounts may be the simulator's own canned citizen replies.

report_detail.prefix: I think that this content is inauthentic (bot) activity because
report_detail.copy_paste: this account posts the same text again and again ({n} identical posts seen), the pattern of an automated spam account.
report_detail.shared_text: the same text is posted word for word by many different new accounts ({n} accounts seen), a coordinated bot campaign.
report_detail.ring: this account is part of a ring of new accounts that reply to the same posts every ~20 seconds with short slogans ({n} such threads seen).
report_detail.ring_anchor: this account's posts are each flooded within minutes by dozens of new accounts replying every ~20 seconds ({n} such posts seen).
report_detail.leak: the text contains language-model output left in by mistake ("{match}").
report_detail.operator: this account belongs to a coordinated network of automated accounts we have observed posting and replying on a fixed schedule.
